name: supination bar suspension stretch
description: Hanging from a bar with palms facing you stretches the biceps and forearms. Let your body weight do the lengthening.
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Let your body hang with your arms straight, relaxing your shoulders downward.
Take as much weight through your legs as you need to stay comfortable.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
